body.zh-Hant: 伊巴涅斯1877年11月3日生於利納雷斯。1896年進入陸軍軍官學校當軍校生；1903年被派往薩爾瓦多執行任務，擔任該國陸軍的教官與教師，一直留到1909年；1912年進入戰爭學院，1916年以參謀軍官身分畢業。
body.en: Ibáñez was born in Linares on 3 November 1877. He entered the Military School as a cadet in 1896. In 1903 he was sent on a mission to El Salvador, where he served as instructor and teacher in that country's army until 1909. He entered the War Academy in 1912 and graduated in 1916 as a General Staff officer.

citations.quote: Nació el 3 de noviembre de 1877 en Linares.
En 1896 ingresó como cadete a la Escuela Militar.
En 1903 fue destinado a realizar una misión a El Salvador
desempeñándose como instructor y profesor del Ejército de ese país
Permaneció hasta 1909
En 1912 ingresó a la Academia de Guerra
egresó como oficial del Estado Mayor en 1916

heading.en: Military intervention and the War Ministry

body.zh-Hant: 1924年9月4日參議院會議上，一批軍官以敲擊佩劍表達對議員津貼案的反對（「軍刀喧嘩」）；伊巴涅斯加入由軍官組成的軍事委員會。1925年1月23日他參與推翻阿爾塔米拉諾軍政府的政變，從1925年1月29日起出任戰爭部長，歷經亞歷山德里與菲格羅亞兩任政府，至1927年2月9日；任內簽署1925年憲法。1927年2月9日至4月7日他兼任內政部長，4月7日至7月21日出任副總統，並宣布於5月22日舉行總統選舉，他是唯一候選人，當選。
body.en: On 4 September 1924, during a Senate session, a group of army officers voiced opposition to a parliamentary allowance by rattling their sabres (the "ruido de sables"), and Ibáñez joined the officers' Military Committee. On 23 January 1925 he took part in a coup that deposed the Altamirano junta, and from 29 January 1925 he served as Minister of War under Presidents Alessandri and Figueroa until 9 February 1927, signing the 1925 Constitution. From 9 February to 7 April 1927 he also held the Interior portfolio in parallel, then was Vice President from 7 April to 21 July 1927, called a presidential election for 22 May 1927, and as the only candidate won it.

citations.quote: En la sesión del Senado del 4 de septiembre de 1924

Entre el 9 de febrero de 1927 y el 7 de abril de 1927 asumió

llamó a elecciones presidenciales a desarrollarse el 22 de mayo de 1927
Fue el único candidato y, como tal, triunfó en las urnas.

body.zh-Hant: 1927年7月21日伊巴涅斯就任總統，領導威權政府，政敵被驅逐或監禁。任內設立共和國審計總署，並把全國劃分為16個省；1929年簽署智利與秘魯的條約，結束塔克納與阿里卡兩省主權爭議。1930年智利受大蕭條波及，銅與硝石價格下跌、失業增加，他於1931年7月26日辭職並流亡阿根廷。
body.en: Ibáñez took office as President on 21 July 1927 and led an authoritarian government in which political enemies were deported or jailed. His administration created the Comptroller General's Office and divided the country into 16 provinces; in 1929 Chile and Peru signed a treaty ending the dispute over Tacna and Arica. In 1930 Chile began to feel the Great Depression, copper and nitrate prices fell and unemployment rose, and he resigned on 26 July 1931 and went into exile in Argentina.

citations.quote: Asumió la primera magistratura el 21 de julio de 1927
encabezando un gobierno autoritario
quienes fueron deportados o encarcelados

Estableció una división territorial de 16 provincias
se firmó el Tratado de 1929 entre Chile y Perú

heading.zh-Hant: 流亡歸國後的政治活動

body.zh-Hant: 1938年他在智利組織並主持人民自由聯盟（Alianza Popular Libertadora），該聯盟含國家社會主義運動並支持他參選總統。1938年9月5日起事青年占領勞工保險局辦公室等處，59名青年死亡；他被拘留，放棄參選，公開支持激進黨的阿吉雷·塞爾達。1939年8月25日他參與反對阿吉雷·塞爾達的政變未遂。1942年他再度參選，獲43.87%選票，敗給胡安·安東尼奧·里奧斯。
body.en: In 1938 he organized and presided over the Alianza Popular Libertadora in Chile, which included the National Socialist Movement and backed his presidential candidacy. On 5 September 1938 the young rebels seized the offices of the Seguro Obrero and 59 of them died; Ibáñez was detained, had to decline his candidacy and publicly backed the Radical candidate Pedro Aguirre Cerda. On 25 August 1939 he took part in a failed coup attempt against President Aguirre Cerda. In 1942 he ran again, won 43.87% of the vote and lost to Juan Antonio Ríos.

body.zh-Hant: 戈麥斯生於1858年，1921年去世（國會圖書館權威檔所載生卒年）。他在十年戰爭期間開始嶄露頭角；美國占領期間在倫納德·伍德將軍治下擔任聖克拉拉省省長。
body.en: Gómez was born in 1858 and died in 1921, according to the Library of Congress name authority. He began his rise to prominence during the Ten Years' War and was governor of Santa Clara during the U.S. occupation under General Leonard Wood.

heading.en: Switch to the Liberal Party and the 1906 insurrection

body.zh-Hant: 戈麥斯原屬保守黨，是個精明而機敏的政治人物；1906年他因保守黨不支持他競選總統而轉入自由黨，並積極參與當年反對總統托馬斯·埃斯特拉達·帕爾馬的武裝起事。
body.en: Described as an astute and clever politician, Gómez, originally a Conservative, switched to the Liberal Party in 1906 when the Conservatives failed to support his bid for the presidency, and he was active in the 1906 insurrection against President Tomás Estrada Palma.

citations.quote: An astute and clever politician
switched from the Conservative to the Liberal Party in 1906
when the former failed to support his bid for the presidency
active in the insurrection against President Tomás Estrada Palma in 1906

body.zh-Hant: 1908年戈麥斯以自由黨候選人身分再度參選並當選，任期為1909至1913年。其政府被指控貪腐與恩庇侍從，並暫停糖等出口品的關稅；政府以支出龐大而著稱，開銷近1.4億美元，並在1912年出兵對付黑人武裝及其支持者獨立有色人黨。他1912年落選，仍活躍於政壇；1920年因反對自由黨政策與國內紛爭而策劃革命，未成功。
body.en: Running on the Liberal Party ticket in 1908, Gómez won and served as president of Cuba from 1909 to 1913. His government was accused of corruption, patronage and suspending duties on sugar and other exports; it was known for large expenditures that approached $140 million, and in 1912 it fought a military campaign against a black military force and its supporters, the Independent Party of Color. Defeated in 1912, he stayed in the political limelight and in 1920 plotted an unsuccessful revolution.

body.zh-Hant: 查孔1873年6月27日生於薩帕卡省的特庫盧坦；祖父是軍官，父親是牧牛場主。他是職業軍人，官至將軍。國會圖書館權威檔載其生卒年為1873至1931年。
body.en: Chacón was born on 27 June 1873 in Teculután, Zacapa; his grandfather was a military officer and his father a cattle rancher. A career army officer, he reached the rank of general. The Library of Congress name authority gives his years as 1873–1931.

A career army officer, General Chacón
Chacón, Lázaro, 1873-1931

heading.en: Assuming the presidency and the 1926 election

body.zh-Hant: 1926年9月27日，查孔在兒時友人何塞·馬里亞·奧雷利亞納將軍心臟病發猝逝的次日接任總統，承諾延續前任政策，並宣示要防止各種社會與政治動盪。1926年12月他在多數自由派支持下輕易贏得總統選舉，對手是進步黨候選人、日後的總統豪爾赫·烏維科。
body.en: Chacón assumed the presidency on 27 September 1926, the day after the fatal heart attack of his boyhood friend General José María Orellana, committed his government to continuing his predecessor's policies and announced his intention to prevent all forms of social and political unrest. Supported by a large majority of Guatemalan liberals, he easily won the December 1926 presidential election against the Progressive Party candidate Jorge Ubico, a future president.

heading.en: Economic crisis and the end of the term

body.zh-Hant: 1920年代末世界性經濟蕭條重創瓜地馬拉經濟時，查孔政府在上層與中產階級間已不得人心，被指管理不善、貪腐與行政無能。1930年12月查孔嚴重中風；政府因他無法視事而陷入猶豫不決，直到1931年2月初豪爾赫·烏維科當選總統。
body.en: When a worldwide depression crippled the Guatemalan economy in the late 1920s, the Chacón government was already unpopular with the upper and middle classes and was accused of mismanagement, corruption and inept administration. In December 1930 Chacón suffered a massive stroke; with him incapacitated the government wallowed in indecision until Jorge Ubico was elected president in early February 1931.
